purpose: Evaluate whether a challenger model-family change has enough evidence and operational controls to advance to a human approval review. This policy cannot approve promotion or customer pricing automatically.

gates.description: A material challenger development signal exists, but development evidence alone cannot authorise review.
The original locked temporal evaluation supports a global model-family change under its registered rule.
At least one genuinely independent preregistered external target gate supports the challenger.
Fresh independent validation remains available for the proposed decision and has not been consumed by candidate selection.
Any evidence relied on for promotion is subject to registered numerical reproducibility controls.
The candidate can be evaluated in shadow mode without customer-pricing authority.
Release selection and rollback controls are demonstrated without automatic pricing changes.
A sealed release can enter only the attested shadow registry, not production/customer pricing.

interpretation_boundaries: This is a project demonstration of model-change governance, not FIRST CENTRAL policy or an insurer approval workflow.
A READY_FOR_HUMAN_COMMITTEE_REVIEW result would still not approve model promotion or customer pricing.
The current persisted evidence is expected to remain EVIDENCE_GAP_HOLD because the external/temporal evidence requirements are not satisfied.
Operational deployability cannot compensate for insufficient validation evidence.
